protocol.environment: Two-step binary MDP; reward is one only for actions (0,1)
protocol.policy: One Bernoulli logit shared across both steps; p=sigmoid(theta)
protocol.gradient: Exact expectation of each tree estimator; true gradient computed analytically
protocol.common_conditions: Same exact state advantages, original-root denominator, initialization, optimizer and step size; no whitening/clipping/momentum
protocol.branching: K is fixed before sampling; one first transition and K+1 on-policy suffixes
protocol.treerl_style: Inverse-square-root aggregation rule only; NOT full TreeRL GA/LA or entropy-based branching
protocol.finite_run: Analytic limits are separate from measured finite-update results. Some biased runs have not converged by 50,000 updates.
protocol.scope: Constructed population-expectation mechanism example; not a finite-sample-budget benchmark or full algorithm comparison
